patterns: 1. Premium Data Flow: PR_ADTRANS/ARC -> EmpPremi -> manualAdjustmentApplier -> PayrollStatistics -> daftar_upah_aggregation_history. 2. Seeder Pattern: DELETE-then-INSERT with progress tracking. 3. Definition-Based: JSON file consumed by PremiumDefinitionService singleton. 4. Identity Resolution: empCode+nik dual identity cascading resolution. 5. Database Routing: SERVER_PROFILE_1 for Plantware+extend_db_ptrj, SERVER_PROFILE_3 for VenusHR14+db_ptrj_mill. 6. clarification_needs.question: How should Excel column mapping work -- by fixed column position (index-based) or by column header name (label-based)?
clarification_needs.context: Current importer uses hardcoded column indices. For a generic seeder supporting all premium types, Excel templates from different divisions may have different column orders. Label-based mapping is more robust but requires header row detection.
options: Fixed index-based: each premium type has pre-configured column order
Header label-based: parser finds columns by name with fuzzy matching
Hybrid: default to index-based, fallback to header-based when headers present
Config file per premium type in premium_definitions.json

clarification_needs.question: Multi-type Excel format -- one premium type per sheet, or all types in one sheet with jenis column?
clarification_needs.context: Current importer expects 1 sheet with jenis column. For multi-type seeding, sheet-per-type is cleaner but requires workbook convention.
options: One sheet per premium type: sheet name equals premium definition name
All types in single sheet: premium_type column plus dynamic columns
Both modes: auto-detect based on sheet count and column presence
Upload one file per premium type only

clarification_needs.question: Import target table -- payroll_manual_adjustments or new dedicated seeder table?
clarification_needs.context: Current flow uses payroll_manual_adjustments which also serves UI manual adjustments. Mixing sources may confuse audits.
options: Use payroll_manual_adjustments with SEEDER: remarks prefix
Add source column to existing table

_metadata.task_description: Build a seeder feature that parses premium data from Excel files and seeds it into premium tables in the database. Each premium type has its own column format. Understand existing premium table formats (Premi Brondol, Premi Prunning, Premi Insentif Panen, Premi Kinerja, Koreksi), Excel-to-table column mapping, and create a reader that maps Excel columns to the appropriate premium tables.
